relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant and Danon disease: "Genetic testing revealed a heterozygous missense variant (c.928G>A) with effect on splicing of lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP-2)".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person, the single unnamed patient of the case report (label 'patient'). The two elder brothers and the parents are mentioned only as 'clinically healthy' (family history), with no genetic testing and no individual-level detail, so they were given no rows. Inheritance left 'not reported': the paper calls the variant de novo ('Family history indicated a de novo mutation, since the two elder brothers and the parents of the patient are clinically healthy'; the abstract says 'Genetic testing revealed a de novo mutation'), but states no parental testing, so rule 8 / D-24 does not allow 'de novo'; parental_testing_statement is 'not reported' for the same reason. Variant type recorded as 'missense' as printed ('heterozygous missense variant (c.928G>A) with effect on splicing'); the authors also describe a splicing effect, but no assay is reported, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'. No transcript or protein change printed. No pathogenicity class stated ('as previously described in Danon disease' is not a classification). Ages: only age at presentation (24 years) is printed; age at onset, last evaluation and diagnosis are not stated as ages (symptoms 'over the past 4 months' before presentation; diagnosis at month 5; follow-up 16 months), so all left 'not reported'. Normal findings recorded per D-27: 'normal CK and CK-MB levels' and CK/CK-MB/CRP 'within normal ranges' -> elevated CK, elevated CK-MB, elevated CRP excluded. The Discussion states 'Our patient did not present any other extra-cardiac symptoms.' after discussing cognitive impairment and muscle weakness; recorded as one excluded feature 'other extra-cardiac symptoms', but by analogy with D-27 (a negative statement excludes nothing more specific than what it names) the specific extra-cardiac checklist items (muscle weakness, cognitive impairment etc.) were left 'not reported'. 'Generalized weakness' at presentation was recorded as observed as written and not mapped to proximal muscle weakness. Left ventricular hypertrophy left 'not reported': only histological cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and septal thickness 11 mm are reported; 'pre-existent genetic (hypertrophic) cardiomyopathy' is a suspicion, not a finding. Ventricular tachycardia checklist item observed from 'non-sustained ventricular tachycardias' (Holter, month 3); sustained VT was explicitly absent at later checks (separate excluded feature, not a contradiction). Vital status 'alive' from the statement that she was clinically stable during the 16-month follow-up. No contradictions found.

span: → Initiation of heart failure therapy and direct acting oral anticoagulant (DOAC) (apixaban)
prior to internal cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD)-CRT-system implantation
Immunosuppressive therapy with prednisolone (1 mg/kg/day, followed by a tapering regimen as specified in the timeline) was initiated.

→ Restarting of immunosuppressive therapy: initial prednisolone pulse therapy with 250 mg i.v. for 3 days, subsequently 1 mg/kg/day prednisolone for 4 weeks, followed by the above-mentioned tapering regimen + treatment intensification with tacrolimus (1 mg 2×/day), and mycophenolate mofetil (500 mg 2×/day)
